# Local transparency resource fixtures

Generated by `cargo run -p render --example group_resources -- fixtures OUTPUT`.
The Rust generator builds a linear-light RGB matrix/TRC ICC profile with moxcms;
all graphics are project-owned paths, without fonts or external image assets.
`manifest.json` pins the committed bytes. Pages are 600 x 840 points.

- local-icc: small isolated linear-RGB group; mixed black/white should convert
  to approximately sRGB 188, rather than 128.
- nested: nonisolated subgroup inside a local isolated ICC group.
- rotated: a transformed local ICC Form; shader clip bounds must not make its
  scratch raster as large as the page.
- soft-mask: a half-alpha soft mask applied to the local ICC group.
- knockout: nonisolated knockout with partially/fully transparent members.
- large-group: genuinely page-sized ICC group; should be refused at 144 DPI
  under the browser's 16,000,000-byte live raster budget, without invalidating
  the document or preventing lower-DPI/tile rendering.

The reported private paper is not part of this directory. Test it explicitly
with the optional RZPDF_GROUP_PDF environment variable of the browser gate.
